An access token has a bounded lifetime

A client obtains a token, presents it, refreshes it when allowed, and lets it expire.

  1. Authorization serversign scope + expiry
  2. Client tokenBearer eyJ...
  3. Resource serververify signature + scope
  4. Expiryreject after 15 min

Authorization has issued a short-lived token to the client.

  1. Issued

    Authorization has issued a short-lived token to the client.

  2. Used

    The resource server verifies the token before serving protected data.

  3. Refreshed

    A valid refresh grant obtains a new access token.

  4. Expired

    An expired token is rejected and must not authorize access.

Authentication establishes trust before protected work begins

Credentials arrive from an untrusted client and are verified only by the identity service.

  1. BrowserCredential proof
  2. Credential proofIdentity service
  3. Identity serviceAuthenticated session
  • Browsersign-in form
  • Credential proofpassword or passkey assertion
  • Identity serviceverify identity
  • Authenticated sessionprincipal + session id

The client proves control of a credential without being trusted yet.

  1. Challenge

    The client proves control of a credential without being trusted yet.

  2. Verified

    The identity service records a verified principal for the session.

    过期令牌必须被拒绝，不能再授权访问。
